experiment: Bench: SMP catheter segment in tissue phantom. Measure: controlled navigation accuracy, buckling behavior, tissue contact force, failure recovery.
pass_rule: Safe closed-loop navigation to target within 5mm accuracy AND tissue force < 0.01 N AND failure recovery demonstrated
fail_rule: Buckling prevents controlled navigation OR tissue force > 0.01 N OR no failure recovery
ambiguous_rule: CI spans pass/fail threshold → AMBIGUOUS (no silent promotion)
cost_estimate: $15-30K (ESTIMATED: SMP prototype + tissue phantom + force sensors)
